newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Foreign funds up investment in Colombian stocks.
newsitem.headline: Foreign funds up investment in Colombian stocks.

text.p: Foreign investment funds had a total of $1.16 billion riding on Colombian stocks as of June, a 22.6 percent increase over the same month last year, the Securities Superintendency said Tuesday.
The figure was down $4 million from the level of fund holdings reported in May, however, when investment in shares by the 186 funds authorized to operate in Colombia reached an all- time high.
As valued in pesos, the funds' total investment in local stocks was 1.26 trillion in June against 1.01 trillion in June 1996.
